# Bonk

> Bonk is a shared focus timer for deep work. Run pomodoro or interval cycles solo, or host live rooms where friends sync on the same timer, earn XP and coins, and stock a pixel-art pantry.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Bonk, the shared focus timer.
- [Solo focus](/solo): Personal pomodoro / interval / stopwatch timer, no account required.
- [Live bonks](/bonks): Browse and join live shared focus rooms, or host your own.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Top focusers ranked by XP, current streak, and longest streak.
- [Shop](/shop): Spend focus-earned coins on pantry snacks and time-limited badges.
- [Sign in](/auth): Username-only sign in with recovery codes.

## Optional

- [Settings](/settings): Account, profile, and preferences (requires sign in).
